name: enistere-foundation
description: Enistere Foundation — Software System Engineering Platform (Governed System Compiler, Evidence-Driven System Evolution Engine). The laboratory factory and starters remain as a compatibility layer until the E10 cutover.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@enistere/api-contracts && npm run build --workspace=@enistere/api-client-fetch
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@enistere/api-contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace=@enistere/api-client-fetch
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@enistere/api-contracts && npm run test --workspace=@enistere/api-contracts && npm run test --workspace=@enistere/api-client-fetch
scripts.pack:dry-run: npm run pack:dry-run --workspace=@enistere/api-contracts && npm run pack:dry-run --workspace=@enistere/api-client-fetch
scripts.example:api-client-node: npm run build --workspace=@enistere/api-contracts && npm run build --workspace=@enistere/api-client-fetch && node examples/api-client-node/smoke.mjs
